\newcommand{\ac}{\mathrm{accepted}}
\newcommand{\ca}{\mathrm{candidate}}
\newcommand{\yin}{y_k^{\mathrm{in}}}
\newcommand{\ma}{m_k^{\ap}}
\newcommand{\Om}{\Omega_k^{\mathrm{FRUIT}}}

\newcommand{\TypePage}{%
\pageunit{The model applied to the data is a separate object}{sec:types}{%
A model accepted for feedback need not be the operand removed from the input.
Acceptance may precede normalization, clipping, sign conversion, support
restriction, projection, unit conversion or another declared transformation.
Scientific accountability therefore needs three objects, even when their
numerical values happen to agree:
\[
 m_k^{\ca}\in M_k^{\ca},\qquad
 m_k^{\ac}\in M_k^{\ac},\qquad
 \ma\in M_k=M_k^{\ap}.
\]
The first is a proposed external or internally constructed candidate; the
second is the model accepted for feedback; the third is the exact operand
used at removal and rejoin. Bind every transformation, if any, among these
spaces and objects, with its rule, causal inputs, state and generation.
Equality of any pair requires an exact method/state fact. Do not assume equal
domain, support, unit, normalization, sign, representation, response,
uncertainty or parentage. A covariance or perturbation attached to the accepted
model is not automatically a covariance or perturbation of the applied model.

The input and result have their own spaces, $\yin\in Y_k$ and $z_k\in Z_k$.
The applied-model space need not equal either. Each space binds physical
quantity, unit and numerical scale, coordinate frame/domain, grid/sampling,
shape and axis/index meaning, timing where relevant, grouping, support,
validity, missing/non-finite causes and generations. The declared target is
also separate: neither the measured input nor an accepted model is true sky
by identity. External models retain their external parent and prior;
internally learned models retain learning parents/population, selection,
response, uncertainty and state generations. Their claim here is only
\texttt{feedback\_model\_state}.

\subsection*{Subtraction requires a common physical reference}
$Y_k$ and $Z_k$ are exact additive quantity spaces, or explicitly identified
affine/quotient spaces with one declared reference and gauge for each
operation and well-defined arithmetic. An affine method must supply exact
additive coordinates; a quotient method must supply well-defined quotient
arithmetic. Arbitrary arithmetic on representatives is not licensed.

For the removal pair and, separately, the rejoin pair, bind compatible
\emph{scientific quantity; unit and numerical scale; coordinate frame/domain;
grid/sampling; support; additive origin/reference or gauge; null-space state;
calibration convention; and response convention}. Record every conversion or
reference/gauge alignment explicitly. Agreement within a pair does not imply
$Y_k=Z_k$. Equal shape, unit labels or masks do not establish compatibility.
A missing compatibility premise makes the affected arithmetic unavailable.

An unavailable absolute or other additive mode remains observationally
unavailable after rejoin. Choosing a gauge changes no measurement authority.
Carry the exact reference, gauge, null-space and mode-origin consequences into
support, response, uncertainty and the bundle.
\src{NOTATION\_AND\_ROLE\_TAXONOMY; SCOPE\_BRIEF \S\S2--3; BOUNDARIES\_AND\_CONVENTIONS B1.}
}}
\newcommand{\NotationAppendix}{%
\pageunit{Notation and source-local cover}{app:notation}{%
\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{.27\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{.66\linewidth}}
\toprule Symbol or role & Exact meaning \\\midrule
$\Pi_k:M_k\to Y_k$ & Projected removal contribution map; not an inferred inverse or numerical projector.\\
$\rho_k\in Y_k$ & Compatible input minus projected applied model.\\
$F_k:Y_k\to Z_k$ & Complete residual-processing procedure; $F_k(\rho_k)$ is the processed residual, not the rejoined result.\\
$B_k:M_k\to Z_k$ & Model contribution map at the exact rejoin point.\\
$S_k,S_{k+1}$ & Scientific state consumed/produced by iteration $k$; $S_0$ is the seed.\\
$A_k:Y_k\to Z_k$ & Exact fixed linear $F_k$, only under its established premises.\\
$D_k:M_k\to Z_k$ & $B_k-A_k\circ\Pi_k$, only under complete fixed linearity of all three maps.\\
$\Om$ & Exact conditioning: parents, operators, support, states, generations, reference/gauge/null-space facts and assumptions held fixed.\\
\texttt{fruit.update\_k} & Separately typed causal increment, model change, diagnostic difference or unavailable role; never inferred from $z_k$.\\
\texttt{fruit.cumulative\_model\_k} & Present only if the method assigns cumulative meaning; distinct from an increment and the accepted/applied model roles.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
New FRUIT notation does not use $x$ or $r$ for generic signal, residual or
model: those symbols remain reserved for paired KID readout coordinates.
Bare $Q_p,N_p,C_p$ and unqualified NOI sign/member symbols are not adopted.
$F_k$ names the residual procedure, never carried feedback state.

The frozen PTC quotation uses source-local $g$ for a detector group and $t$
for a time sample. Its $x_{g,t}$ is called \texttt{PTC.centered\_row} in new
FRUIT prose; $\widehat A_g$ is \texttt{PTC.loading\_matrix}; its coefficients
are \texttt{PTC.application\_coefficients}; $W^{\rm app}_{g,t}$,
$G^{\rm app}_{g,t}$ and $\Theta_g$ are respectively
\texttt{PTC.application\_influence}, \texttt{PTC.normal\_matrix} and
\texttt{PTC.resolved\_group\_state}. This cover does not rename KID readout
coordinates or modify the frozen equations. PTC-local symbols are not FRUIT
model or operator aliases.
\src{NOTATION\_AND\_ROLE\_TAXONOMY; BOUNDARIES\_AND\_CONVENTIONS B2.}
}}
